node_type_vocabulary.owner: the live-plane CloudNode graph read by comp-find --corpus aws. Every type key in this file (kind.by_type and types_not_graded_by_kind) IS a node_type value that instrument returns, spelled exactly as it returns it.
node_type_vocabulary.measured: comp-find --corpus aws '.' --budget 600 by 1.0.0_SA_CTO 2026-09-13 ~22:4xZ; graph vintage 'Built from the estate as of 2026-09-13 12:15:54 UTC', manifest 48bf196564e6; 2,531 nodes, 33 node types

key.source: a registry VENDOR key (a feed) or, for derived tiers, a PRODUCT or SYSTEM key
key.table_case: snake_case; a platinum leaf is a kebab-case .json file (the served names)

resource.scope_when_shared: OMITTED -- a shared resource carries no scope token, never a placeholder
resource.function: one or more kebab tokens naming what it does; a compound such as silver-chain is ONE function token
resource.qualifier: optional narrowing: a table, a leg, or an environment (dev | prod)

kind.closed_at_l4: By subtraction from the live plane's 33 node types: ECS_TASK_DEFINITION, STATE_MACHINE, LOAD_BALANCER and ECS_CLUSTER had no kind in the brief's list -- added as task, sfn, lb and cluster (the last two each have one live node, opal-gateway and opal-globgrph, and are resources this estate mints). secret was DROPPED: secrets keep their own slash-path grammar, where a kind suffix would repeat the type. The brief's measured suffixes trigger, publisher, scanner are FUNCTION tokens, not kinds.

types_not_graded_by_kind.EVENT_RULE: resource grammar with a CADENCE as the last slot (resource.last_slot)
types_not_graded_by_kind.SCHEDULE: resource grammar with a CADENCE as the last slot (resource.last_slot)
types_not_graded_by_kind.LOG_GROUP: derived: /aws/{service}/{resource-name}; conforms when its resource does (log_group)
types_not_graded_by_kind.S3_BUCKET_POLICY: carries its bucket's name exactly (15 of 15 live nodes); graded as that bucket
types_not_graded_by_kind.IAM_USER: NOT GRADED: named by its holder or issuer -- a person, the account root, an external identity provider named by its issuer URL (4 live nodes). The one machine user among them (github-actions-portal) is recorded, not graded; a remediation that converts it to a role takes the role grammar
types_not_graded_by_kind.ROUTE53_RECORD: NOT GRADED: a DNS record name (not_covered)
types_not_graded_by_kind.API_ROUTE: NOT GRADED: a served route contract (not_covered; infra/logic/07_ROUTING_REDERIVATION.md)
types_not_graded_by_kind.EVENT_SOURCE: NOT GRADED: an event-source expression or service name, a different grammar (not_covered)

firm_forms.note: one token; the long and short forms are the same string

refused_tokens.bd: refused in EVERY slot (Andrew ~03:5xZ card 2). The vendor is blackdiamond; the firm is 49financial.
refused_tokens.mockadv: an alias only, recorded in the registry's alias rows as history; never minted

system.vendor_as_system_only_when: the resource IS the vendor integration

reserved.opal: account-level platform resources only; never a null prefix before a real system

grade.signature: (name, type) -> (verdict, canonical_form); type is a node_type value (node_type_vocabulary)
grade.ALIAS: the grammar holds but a slot carries a registry alias spelling (for example inflection or bd in a resource name's scope slot); canonical_form is printed
grade.OUT-OF-PATTERN: the grammar fails (order, separator, case, a missing or unknown kind, a firm in the system slot); canonical_form is printed
grade.not_graded: a type marked NOT GRADED in types_not_graded_by_kind returns no verdict and is outside the grade's domain -- it is excluded, not a fourth verdict
grade.unplaceable: RAISES. A name the tokeniser cannot place, a node_type absent from this file, or a token no registry row resolves, is a defect in the tokeniser, this file or the registry and is fixed there -- it is never filed under one of the three verdicts, and there is no fourth

not_covered: Terraform resource labels and module names (the executable layer's authoring surface; measured before its flagger is specified)
AWS-issued identifiers (KMS key ids, CloudFront distribution ids, service principals, VPC endpoint ids)
API route grammar (a served contract; infra/logic/07_ROUTING_REDERIVATION.md)
renames_authorized: NONE. This schema grades; it moves no live name. Each remediation is minted where the resource lives, cites a row of the tension ranking, and carries its own sign-off.
